title: My Brother Forged A $1 Sale, Stole My $220K Inheritance. So I Let Dad's Cassette Tape Do The Talking
description: When my father's will left me his priceless Blue Note jazz LP collection, my brother forged a $1 bill of sale and cashed out for $280,000. A dated cassette tape of Dad's voice proved the fraud in probate, and now my brother polishes my record store shelves wearing a shirt that says "Scratched Lies." #Revenge #VinylJustice #FamilyBetrayal
thumb_text: NOW HE POLISHES MY SHELVES IN A ‘SCRATCHED LIES’ SHIRT
pinned_comment: If you found a cassette tape of your late father catching your own brother in a forged $1 record sale, what would you do? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I FOUND A DATED CASSETTE TAPE IN HIS HOSPITAL ROOM
